CustomObject.description: Data-plane Platform Event for Skywave Interactive. Published by Apex REST endpoints from the consumer site. Consumed by the monitor LWC ONLY (the WS relay does not subscribe — phones don't care what other phones did). Type discriminator: session_started, survey_answer, profile_created, race_tick. New types are added by extending the Type__c values, not by creating new channels.
CustomObject.label: Demo Event
